findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_email_messages, get_email_code, delete_email_inbox · Private data: private_blind_lookup, extract_company_contacts, url_to_clean_markdown, muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder · Public sink: detect_website_tech_stack, get_company_open_jobs, find_hot_buyers, batch_lookup, extract_company_contacts, muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder, create_email_inbox, list_email_messages, get_email_code, delete_email_inbox · Destructive: ask_hirepulse_advisor, get_google_ads_by_domain, get_company_profile, batch_lookup, list_email_messages, get_email_code, delete_email_inbox.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_email_messages, get_email_code, delete_email_inbox · Private data: private_blind_lookup, extract_company_contacts, url_to_clean_markdown, muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder · Public sink: detect_website_tech_stack, get_company_open_jobs, find_hot_buyers, batch_lookup, extract_company_contacts, muse_conversion_leak_lead_finder, create_email_inbox, list_email_messages, get_email_code, delete_email_inbox · Destructive: ask_hirepulse_advisor, get_google_ads_by_domain, get_company_profile, batch_lookup, list_email_messages, get_email_code, delete_email_inbox

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
